name.title: Name
name.description: What it is for: `training job`, `my laptop`

AccessTokenOut.title: AccessTokenOut
AccessTokenOut.description: A token as the list shows it: never the token itself.

output_path.title: Output Path
output_path.description: Keys, and numbers for the places in a list: `predictions.0.label`. Empty: the whole answer

ApiIn.title: ApiIn
ApiIn.description:
The API of a service that is not an MLflow server. The relay sends `POST {address}{path}` with the JSON
`{input_field: <the input>}`, and gives back what is at `output_path` in the answer.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where the image is served from: it needs a login and the right to see the feedback.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Where each file goes, in the order of the files

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Paths of the files to take out

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A commit, a tag or a branch

ref_kind.title: Ref Kind
ref_kind.description: A commit is recognised by itself; a tag and a branch cannot be told apart

entrypoint.title: Entrypoint
entrypoint.description: The file that runs the model, `src/predict.py`

CodeIn.title: CodeIn
CodeIn.description:
The code a version points to: a repository on an allowed host (GitHub, GitLab), and where to start in it. Only a
link: nothing is fetched or cloned when it is sent.

CodeOut.title: CodeOut
CodeOut.description: The code reference as it was written, and what a worker found of it.

CodeVersionIn.title: CodeVersionIn
CodeVersionIn.description: A version that is only a link to the code.

CreatedAccessTokenOut.title: CreatedAccessTokenOut
CreatedAccessTokenOut.description: The answer to making a token, and the only time `token` is given: it cannot be read again.

DatasetChange.title: DatasetChange
DatasetChange.description: What to change: the fields that are not sent stay as they are, and at least one is needed.

DatasetIn.title: DatasetIn
DatasetIn.description: A dataset to create. Its address is `{your name}/{name}`; the name and the modality can never be changed.

DatasetMemberIn.title: DatasetMemberIn
DatasetMemberIn.description: `reader` sees a private dataset, `annotator` also annotates it, `maintainer` also changes it.

DatasetSummaryOut.title: DatasetSummaryOut
DatasetSummaryOut.description: A line of the list: no card.

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: The alias it serves in the registry (`production`)

auth_value.title: Auth Value
auth_value.description: Never read back. Send the header alone to keep the value that is already there

EndpointIn.title: EndpointIn
EndpointIn.description:
Where a model is served. `mlflow`: an MLflow model server (it must answer `/ping`). `custom`: a service of
your own, with its `api`. The address must be on a server the administrators allow.

EndpointOut.title: EndpointOut
EndpointOut.description: For the editors. The value of the login is never here.

version.title: Version
version.description: The number of the version of the model that was evaluated

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: `owner/name` of a dataset you can read: what the predictions are compared to

split.title: Split
split.description: `train`, `test`... one of the splits of the dataset

target_column.title: Target Column
target_column.description: The column of the dataset that holds the right answer

key_column.title: Key Column
key_column.description: A column of the dataset that identifies each item, also in the file of predictions. Empty: the line of the file is the position of the item in the split, from 0

input_column.title: Input Column
input_column.description: The column the model read, for the record

prediction_column.title: Prediction Column
prediction_column.description: The column of the file with the prediction

size.title: Size
size.description: The size of the file of predictions, in bytes

inference.description: How long it took and on what: what you say, not checked

EvaluationStartIn.title: EvaluationStartIn
EvaluationStartIn.description:
An evaluation to start: which model version, on which part of which dataset, and the predictions that will be
sent to compare with it. The platform computes the metrics; a person never sends one.

FeedbackChange.title: FeedbackChange
FeedbackChange.description: What to change: the fields that are not sent stay as they are, and at least one is needed.

FeedbackSummaryOut.title: FeedbackSummaryOut
FeedbackSummaryOut.description: A line of a list: no description, no screenshots.

FeedbackTypeUpdate.title: FeedbackTypeUpdate
FeedbackTypeUpdate.description: What to change: the fields that are not sent stay as they are.

HardwareIn.title: HardwareIn
HardwareIn.description: What the predictions were made on. For predictions a person sent: what they say, the platform cannot check.

HardwareOut.title: HardwareOut
HardwareOut.description: What the predictions were made on (plain values: what was checked going in is not checked again).

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: The time the model took to make all the predictions

InferenceIn.title: InferenceIn
InferenceIn.description: How the predictions were made: how long it took, and on what.

MessageOut.title: MessageOut
MessageOut.description: An answer, or a change of status (then `body` is empty and `old_status_id` and `new_status_id` say which).

ModelChange.title: ModelChange
ModelChange.description:
What to change: the fields that are not sent stay as they are, and at least one is needed. `code_url` and
`parameters` can be sent as null to take them off.

ModelIn.title: ModelIn
ModelIn.description: A model to create. Its address is `{your name}/{name}`; the name, tasks and inputs can never be changed.

ModelSummaryOut.title: ModelSummaryOut
ModelSummaryOut.description: A line of the list: no card.

ModelUploadIn.title: ModelUploadIn
ModelUploadIn.description: The files of a version, announced before they are sent. `remove` takes paths out in the same version.

NotificationIn.title: NotificationIn
NotificationIn.description: What an application sends to tell users something: the same words for each of them.

NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead
NotificationRead.description: What to set: read, or unread again.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: The numbers of the parts, from 1

RowsOut.title: RowsOut
RowsOut.description: A page of the rows of a split, in the order of the columns.

ServingOut.title: ServingOut
ServingOut.description: What a person who may read the model knows of how it is tried: no address, no login, no API.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Its fingerprint, if the browser knows it: a file the dataset already holds is not sent again

UploadFileIn.title: UploadFileIn
UploadFileIn.description: A file the browser is going to send.

UploadIn.title: UploadIn
UploadIn.description: The files of a version, announced before they are sent. `remove` takes paths out in the same version.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version it made, once it is complete

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: The logged-in user, as the frontend sees them. Never the tokens.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: The numbers of the parts, from 1
